series_start_reason: Tabrecta's first sales (6) are printed only as the Q2 2020 prior-year column of the Q2 2021 report: the Q2 2020 report itself (0001370368-20-000069) prints no Tabrecta sales row. series_end_reason: From the Q1 2024 interim report (0001370368-24-000017, a240423-99_2.htm) Novartis no longer prints a Tabrecta net sales row: its Oncology table lists Kisqali, Promacta/Revolade, Jakavi, Tafinlar + Mekinist, Tasigna, Lutathera, Kymriah and 'Other', and Tabrecta does not occur anywhere in that report or in the Q2 2024 through Q2 2026 reports. The Q4 2023 report (0001370368-24-000007) is the last with a Tabrecta row (Q4 2023 41; FY 2023 154).
notes: Novartis group net sales of Tabrecta as a single row of the product net sales table.
